description: Hover over an element, by CSS selector or ref. Default: synthetic mouseenter/mouseover/mousemove, which fire JS hover handlers but not CSS :hover. trusted moves the real mouse pointer (chrome.debugger), so CSS :hover rules and their transitions apply.

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

trusted.description: Real browser pointer via chrome.debugger, main frame only: needed for CSS :hover

name: hover
